name: Amazon SBD2 Fulfillment Center San Bernardino CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Black metal sliding/swing gate across the controlled entrance drive off S Waterman Ave (east side); continuous metal perimeter fence confirmed in Street View along the full Waterman frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Staffed security building (red/maroon hip roof, multi-window) sits just inside the gate beside the entrance auto-court; visible in satellite z20 and Street View behind the gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard building is present; a call-box/kiosk pedestal also sits at the curb cut (belt-and-suspenders), but the booth makes this guarded, not remote.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved auto-court / interior staging plaza inside the gate before docks, with landscaped islands.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-dock approach across a wide auto court and internal yard roads; easily holds 3+ trucks queued.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron and large auto court with unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band; long dock banks on the south and west/north faces of the SBD2 building with trailers backed in. Exact count (~90) is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band; extensive organized trailer-drop rows north (between buildings) and along the west edge.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on physically distinct building faces (south bank vs north/west bank) suggests separate ship/receive clusters; medium confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single consolidated entrance/exit point at the NE auto-court off Waterman; in/out share the same gate group.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large building clusters on the campus (southern solar-roof SBD2 building plus the adjacent northern warehouse) sharing the drop yard between them.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad identified in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is not connected.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the traced perimeter polygon (~89 acres) covering the southern building and its dock/drop yards.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Dense Inland Empire industrial corridor adjacent to I-215/I-10; strong cellular coverage expected.
